about.title: The Kynex story
about.subtitle: The AI community — why this platform exists, and who's behind it.
about.whyBody1: AI is a huge, fast-moving field, but there isn't a clear, large Arabic learning ecosystem around it the way there is for other programming fields (web, mobile...). Lots of people want to learn AI but struggle to find organized resources, real projects to work on, or a community to support them along the way.
about.whyBody2: We picked the name Kynex deliberately — a fully invented name with no dictionary meaning, chosen because it evokes the energy and speed of next-generation technology. Kynex was built to close that gap — a place where you can find ready datasets, training code, and model architectures in different languages, share your own work, and learn from others', without feeling like you're on the journey alone.
about.whatBody: An open public space: you upload your project (with a clear license that protects your rights), people browse it, download it, learn from it, and reach out if they have a question. We don't store the trained models themselves — they go straight to your own HuggingFace account, so ownership and control stay fully in your hands.
about.whoBodyPrefix: Kynex is the idea and work of
about.whoBodySuffix: , who noticed the gap in Arabic AI education compared to other programming fields, and decided to build a place where support and resources are available to anyone interested in learning and contributing to this field.

terms.title: Terms of Use & Privacy Policy
terms.s1Body: The platform is a public space for developers to share AI projects (training code, model architectures, datasets). All published projects are public and available to any visitor.
terms.s2Body: The user who uploads content is fully and solely responsible for it — whether it's code, a dataset, a description, or a comment. The platform does not review all content before publishing and relies on a user reporting system. The platform is not liable for any damage resulting from the use of content uploaded by a third party, including (without limitation) code containing bugs, security vulnerabilities, or content that infringes intellectual property.
terms.s3Body: Every published project comes with a license chosen by its owner at upload time (a standard license or a custom one). Using any project means you fully accept the terms of the license specified on its page. The platform does not verify ownership claims at upload time, and the responsibility for making sure no third-party rights are violated lies with the uploader.
terms.s4Body: All your sensitive data (password, HuggingFace token, and any other personal data) is stored fully encrypted on our servers. We do not sell your data to any third party. The HuggingFace token is used exclusively to upload your models to your own HuggingFace account, and for no other purpose.
terms.s5Body: By creating an account on the platform, you explicitly agree to these terms in full. Continuing to use the platform after any update to these terms is considered implicit acceptance of the updated version.
terms.s6Body: When you request account deletion, the account enters a 30-day delayed-deletion period during which you can log in and reverse the decision at any time. After this period ends, your account and all its associated projects are permanently and irreversibly deleted.
terms.s7Body: The platform's administration reserves the right to ban any account that violates these terms, based on a review of user reports, without a mandatory prior notice.
terms.s8Body: For any inquiry related to these terms or your personal data, contact us at [contact email — fill this in].
